_comment: Vehicle registry — the Operator Station's canonical vehicle identity, data-driven.
Loaded by vehicle_registry.load_registry() at startup (override the path with the
OPERATOR_VEHICLE_REGISTRY environment variable). Adding a USV means adding an entry
here and restarting the backend — no code change anywhere in the station.
key          canonical id, written as the slug 'usv-<n>' (the numeric id is derived
from it, or declared explicitly with 'id')
display_name what operators see. NEVER an identity: a vehicle may change it, and no
state, cache, command or selection is ever keyed by it
aliases      every other spelling THIS vehicle may use for itself in a status packet
(callsigns, hull names, bare numbers). Explicit only — the station never
guesses an alias, because a guess could merge two different vehicles.
The key, its slug and its bare number are always aliases of themselves.
An alias claimed by two vehicles is a hard startup error, not a silent last-one-wins.
